non_medical_boundary: Blissiree supports emotional wellbeing and personal development. It does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent medical conditions, and individual results vary.
app_overview: Blissiree offers a 30-minute Brain Reset, a Boost Library with more than 200 sleep-based brain-retraining audios and curated playlists, plus structured personal-development programs.

offerings.name: Boost Library
offerings.details: More than 200 brain-retraining audios and curated playlists for areas such as stress, anxious thinking, sleep and emotional balance. Audio is designed for low or whisper-volume use while resting or sleeping.

offerings.name: Emotional Empowerment Program
offerings.details: A structured 14-session personal-development journey for people aged 13 and above, focused on longer-standing emotional patterns, beliefs, fears, perceptions and emotional responses.

offerings.name: Unstoppable You Program
offerings.details: An adult program for people aged 18 and above, focused on performance, focus, resilience, confidence, direction and personal growth.

offerings.name: Consultations with Terri
offerings.details: The official site describes a free 25-minute discovery call, an introductory session and a personalised 14-session journey. Availability and current commercial details should be confirmed on the consultation page.
